turns.mechanic: Tesla Model 3 2021 in limp mode with DIRER_a149_oilPumpFailure.
Replaced the rear drive unit oil pump. Now there is a software-related problem with the oil pump controller and the car is not back to normal.
Did a software reinstall and the fault cleared. Limp mode is gone.
